chunks: Ahmad, from al-Husayn, from Hammad ibn 'Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah, who said:
He used to perform istinja' from urine three times, and from feces with clods of earth and rags.

key_terms.الْخِرَقِ: rags or cloth pieces used for cleansing
key_terms.الْمَدَرِ: clods of earth used for cleansing
key_terms.يَسْتَنْجِي: to perform istinja', meaning cleansing the private area after relieving oneself

ai.seo_question: How was istinja' performed from urine and feces according to this hadith in Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a practice of istinja' after relieving oneself, specifying washing from urine three times and cleansing from feces using clods of earth and cloths. It is significant in the fiqh of taharah, as it preserves details of practical purification etiquette transmitted in the hadith tradition.
